svg.text: One problem, from session to proven fix.
cause: instruction gap. AGENTS.md never says where models go.
other causes: model ignored a rule, operator was vague, unknown
↓ proof: the guess tested in a sandbox, with the real context
replay from the step before the mistake, 5 runs
the same 5 runs, with the new text
shows the diff and 4/5 → 0/5, writes it, deletes the sandbox
If the operator was vague, repro says what was unclear and how to say it next time, and stops after step 2.
